historical_proxy_validation.scope: Annual January origins 2010 onward; 50/50 SPY/QQQ buy-and-hold proxy, NOT actual-household or company-level calibration. Long horizons overlap, are few and dependent. Data vendor adjustments are current-vintage; fundamentals/holdings selection not backtested.

calibration_status: Conditional model estimates; no demonstrated household calibration or live track record. Historical proxy diagnostics are limited and do not prove real-world odds.
income_policy: Provider total-return convention: dividends reinvested into the same security; static starting positions with reinvested income, no cross-security rebalancing; fund expenses embedded once.
limitations: Unverified full account balances and options excluded, not assumed zero.
Market drift is a historical estimate, not an intrinsic-value forecast; 3% reference rate and zero sector/stock alpha are modeling assumptions.
Mean uncertainty is sampled, but factor loadings and company covariance estimation uncertainty is not fully modeled.
Residual innovations are Gaussian; factor shocks retain historical blocks. Unseen tail events and company failure probabilities are not calibrated.
Explicit permanent-loss stress has no assigned probability; baseline excludes a calibrated bankruptcy process.
Monthly drawdown monitoring misses intramonth falls.
GOOGL shares GOOG growth paths; QQQM shares QQQ total-return paths, ignoring small fee/tracking differences.
Residual correlations are pairwise-estimated, shrunk 25% toward zero off-diagonal, then projected to positive semidefinite.
Current holdings and current-vintage adjusted prices entail selection/revision limitations in historical diagnostics.
ETF constituent weights remain unverified; ETFs modeled as funds, never double-counted.
